com.viaoa.uicontroller

Class OAUISelectController

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.viaoa.uicontroller.OAUISelectController

  • public abstract class OAUISelectController
extends Object
    Used by UI Components that use a Hub to present a list to choose from. Once a value is selected then it will set the AO in the Hub. If there is a Link Hub, then the new select Value will be verified before setting. For multi-select, it uses a hubSelect.
    Author:
    vince
